# VeloxSync for Education

> AI-powered homeschool planning for families. Built for homeschool parents, using Claude to help plan lessons, track progress, and support up to six children under one Family Plan.

Built by Meraki is Love, LLC (Soulful Tech), the team behind VeloxSync.

## Product
- [Homepage](https://education.veloxsync.app/): Overview and Family Plan details ($19/month or $149/year, up to six children)
- [Login](https://education.veloxsync.app/education/login)
- [Support](https://education.veloxsync.app/support)
- [FAQ](https://education.veloxsync.app/education/faq)
- [Privacy Policy](https://education.veloxsync.app/education/privacy)
